name: Transkriptor
tagline: Transkriptor is an AI transcription service that converts audio and video files, Zoom recordings, and live speech into accurate text in 100+ languages. It offers speaker labeling, subtitle export, and AI-generated meeting summaries for business, academic, and media use cases.
